concerns.text: T004 writes and validates connectivity JSON records against contracts/connectivity.schema.yaml BEFORE T005 corrects that contract. Until T005 lands, the contract marks strength_absolute as required/primary and strength_signed as optional — the inverse of FR-005 — so T004's deliverable momentarily validates against a spec-contradicting schema. Reorder T005 before T004, or have T004 write records only in the post-T005 shape.

T009 (sensitivity analysis) and the SC-007 power note are plan-derived additions with no spec FR/SC authorizing them. The kickback flag is good, but the tasks document should state explicitly that these are STAGED pending spec amendment (per the sanctioned staging convention) so the deliverable is not read as silently satisfying an unamended requirement — currently only T007 labels its power note 'not a spec SC'.

The timeseries contract's `data` description still reads 'BOLD signal values after confound regression', contradicting FR-004's raw-signal requirement that T003 implements. T005 updates connectivity.schema.yaml and data-model.md but does not list timeseries.schema.yaml's data description among its edits; add it so the contract matches the spec-authoritative raw time-series mandate.
